Aklas

  • Hometown: Las Pinas, Iloilo
  • Reppin: Mulat Krew, Batch 1, S.O.S
  • Division: Metro Manila
  • Year Joined: 2010
  • Isabuhay 2013 Champion

Aklas was part of the very first Process of Illumination and despite not reaching the finals, his impressive freestyle skills were enough to land him a spot in the roster.
